MILKDROP_TRIG_FAST_LIMIT.description: Maximum absolute angle in radians accepted by the fast sine/cosine path; larger values use the libm fallback.

MILKDROP_FPS_BASELINE.description: Nominal baseline playback frame-rate option and default; benchmark eligibility adjusts this rate to the display refresh profile.

MILKDROP_FPS_HIGH.description: Nominal playback frame-rate option for every display refresh; benchmark eligibility adjusts this rate to the display refresh profile.

MILKDROP_COLOR_CURVE_BRIGHTEN.description: Brighten bit in the rendered colour-curve mode and benchmark validation mode.

MILKDROP_COLOR_CURVE_DARKEN.description: Darken bit in the rendered colour-curve mode and benchmark validation mode.

MILKDROP_COLOR_CURVE_SOLARIZE.description: Solarize bit in the rendered colour-curve mode and benchmark validation mode.

MILKDROP_COLOR_CURVE_MASK.description: All colour-curve effect bits. Nonzero combinations form the contiguous validation mode IDs 1 through this mask; zero means no effect.

MILKDROP_BENCHMARK_FPS_DECIMALS.description: Decimal places saved for steady benchmark FPS; eligibility thresholds use the same rounding precision.
